name: IC Sensor — I2C — SOIC
description: Cluster of SMD I2C sensor ICs in SOIC packaging with SOIC-8 footprints (3.9x4.9mm, 1.27mm pitch), including magnetic and temperature sensors.
selection_hints: Select for surface-mount sensor ICs using an I2C communication interface.
Choose when using SOIC-8 land patterns with 1.27mm pitch and 3.9x4.9mm body size.
Use for temperature sensing (LM75B, LM92CIM, TMP411) or magnetic sensing (AS5510-DSO).
avoid_when: The board design requires through-hole components or non-SOIC packages.
The sensor interface must be non-I2C, such as SPI or analog.
A footprint other than SOIC-8_3.9x4.9mm_P1.27mm is needed.
